domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 文中研究的CRTS III型板式无砟轨道结构。
usage_overview: 指包含预制轨道板、自密实混凝土层和混凝土底座等的板式无砟轨道，以自密实混凝土替代早期板式轨道中的CA砂浆填充层。用于列车—轨道耦合动力分析，考察温度变形、层间接触对列车通过响应的影响，也用于不同轨道结构的对比。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

complete_examples.text: In this paper, a high-speed train–CRTS III slab track–subgrade coupled dynamic model is established.

With this background, the China railway track system (CRTS) III slab track was researched and developed by China to overcome the shortcomings of the CRTS I slab track [2], CRTS II slab track [3], and the double-block ballastless track [4].
